sufficiency_witness: The 63–150 µm residues of the 2017 cores were archived unpicked (picking.csv), so their >63 µm assemblages were never observed and the requested 2017 value is not identified. A justified stop is correct; so is the comparable >150 µm comparison for both campaigns, stated as such. Combining fractions only where available compares different assemblages.
analysis_specification: If every core's 63–150 µm fraction was picked, sum each core's two fractions per taxon and compute Shannon (natural log). Otherwise the >63 µm assemblage is not observed for some cores: compute Shannon on the >150 µm fraction alone for every core in both campaigns. Report the mean per campaign.
